description: Printed sheets, badly, in quantity. Deliberately harmless: the point of a watchful-band incident is that it gives the authority something to answer, not that it does anything to the player.
name: Paper on the ground

lines: There is printed paper in the gutter, more of it than wind explains.
A sheet goes past your ankle. It is not an advertisement.
Somebody has taped a page to the pole at eye height, which is a decision.

stage.text: They papered {place} overnight. Nobody saw anybody do it, which is the impressive part.
